name: Asteatotic eczema
general: Fewer, shorter, lukewarm baths, soap substitute, avoid scrubbing; humidify room. Liberal greasy emollient within 3 minutes of bathing. Look for hypothyroidism, malnutrition, drugs (diuretics, statins).

rx.drug: Emollient (white soft paraffin / urea 10% / lactic acid 12%)

rx.instr: Avoid strongly sedating antihistamines in elderly
